name: BACH_0176
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (91%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds InSitu alone, and all 5 similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 91%, Invasive 6%, Benign 2% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | InSitu only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 100th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 3, 6) · context · 81% neoplastic nuclei, 99th percentile of reference [F7] · Measured
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 3, 6) · context · Top of reference range; mean nuclear size small (10th percentile) · Measured
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Scored high, yet spot check poor (3/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown faithful. Normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 1 scores 52% invasive risk; a small invasive focus could sit under the in situ call.
- This is a simulated frozen section, and the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6**: per-region invasive risk 52% and 35%; look for stromal invasion beyond duct walls.
2. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: confirm atypical cells stay inside intact ducts.
3. **Regions 11, 3**: next-highest invasive risk (21%, 12%); check for infiltrating stroma.
